_why: What a real PMS does with an ITEM-label filter on GET /library/sections/{key}/all, and whether a
show's leafCount counts Season 0. Issue #151: Shortlist finds Agregarr's trailer stand-ins by the
`trailer-placeholder` label Agregarr puts on them, and item labels are not inline in a listing
(see pms_collections_listing.json for the same fact about collections), so a filtered listing is the
only cheap way to find them. Measured read-only with the owner token; counts only, no titles.
Conclusions the code relies on:
1. `label=<name>` and `label!=<name>` take the tag NAME and are honoured: the two partition a library
exactly (10053 + 11 = 10064). So a reader can check its own answer: positives + negatives must
equal the library total, and a filter this endpoint ignored (it answers an ignored parameter with
the whole library, see pms_watched_incremental.xml.txt) fails that check instead of reading as
'every item is a placeholder'.
2. The match is case-insensitive (exact, lower and upper case give the same count), which matters
because Plex title-cases a tag it creates.
3. `includeLabels=1` inlines nothing: still 0 items carrying <Label> in the first 200.
4. A request with no X-Plex-Container-Size answers the whole filtered set in one page.
5. A show's leafCount INCLUDES its Season 0 episodes (every one of 28 shows with specials checked:
e.g. 21 = 1 special + 10 + 10). So Agregarr's S00E00 trailer makes a trailer-only show read
1 of 1 episodes watched after one play, which the finished-show rule reads as finished.
Not recorded here: an Agregarr placeholder item itself. This server had none on the day. Its shape is
taken from Agregarr's source (bitr8/agregarr-dev @fa600a14): a movie stand-in is a separate item, a
`{edition-Trailer}` file matched to the film's own tmdb id; a TV stand-in is Season 00/S00E00.Trailer.mp4
under the show, and the label goes on the SHOW.
show_children: GET /library/metadata/{show}/children for a real show with specials, shape only (titles
and keys dropped). Seasons are <Directory type="season" index=...>; the 'All episodes' entry listed first
carries no type and no index. That is what `_only_season_zero` reads. Not recorded: a library with 'hide
seasons' on (flattenSeasons=1), where /children lists episodes; neither show library here has it on.
